 For the State : Mr. S.K. Tiwari, A.P.P.
 ----
 th
 03/Dated: 19 August, 2023
1.
Heard learned senior counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 19.01.2023 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Daltonganj Town P.S. Case No.03 of 2023, registered for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Special Judge, Pocso Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.

3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
4.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned senior counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that FIR has been lodged after four years and the girl is just below the age of 15 years.
Further, due to neighbourhood dispute the present applicant has been implicated in this case.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. From perusal of the repot, it appears that the case is at the stage of evidence and two witnesses have already been examined.
7. Considering the nature of allegation and stage of the trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands rejected.
8. However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same within four months from today.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
